paper.title: Task-Optimized Convolutional Recurrent Networks Align with Tactile Processing in the Rodent Brain
paper.summary: Task-optimized convolutional recurrent neural networks trained on realistic tactile inputs align with rodent somatosensory data, suggesting brain tactile processing uses temporally-precise representations shaped by categorization-driven optimization.
